blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Philippines — The Mandaue City Government is planning to establish an amateur boxing federation aimed at providing a more organized training and development program for young boxers from various barangays in the city. Mandaue-born former world title challenger and trainer Edito “Ala” Villamor presented the proposal during his visit to the office of Mayor Thadeo Jovito “Jonkie” Ouano on Tuesday, September 22, accompanied by two of his most decorated Cebuano boxers who have earned international recognition. “Nalipay ug excited kaayo ko sa proposal para sa Amateur Boxing Grassroots Program sa Mandaue City,” Villamor said.
